title: WAF IP
description: Gestione degli IP client: bloccati, in parte bloccati, mai bloccati, con paese e provider (GeoIP).

list.name: site
list.label: Sito
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM waf.agg_requests_1m WHERE minute > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY site_id

list.name: stato
list.label: Stato IP
list.query: Sempre bloccati : bloccato, In parte bloccati : misto, Mai bloccati : consentito

list.name: paese
list.label: Paese
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') AS geo FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY geo

panels.title: IP distinti
panels.description: IP client visti nel periodo (con i filtri in alto).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') IN (${paese:singlequote})) GROUP BY ip HAVING ('__all__' IN (${stato:singlequote}) OR multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') IN (${stato:singlequote})))

panels.title: Sempre bloccati
panels.description: IP con tutte le richieste bloccate dal WAF.

panels.title: Da dove arrivano gli IP — 🔴 IP bloccati, 🟢 IP mai bloccati (dimensione = numero di IP)
panels.description: Localizzazione per paese (GeoIP DB-IP/MaxMind). Gli IP di reti private (LAN) e quelli non presenti nel database GeoIP non compaiono sulla mappa: vedi la tabella. Clic su un cerchio per i numeri.

targets.rawSql: SELECT geo AS Paese, count() AS IP, sum(req) AS Richieste, countIf(blk > 0) AS `IP bloccati`, countIf(blk = 0) AS `IP mai bloccati`, sum(blk) AS `Richieste bloccate` FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') GROUP BY geo HAVING `IP mai bloccati` > 0

SELECT geo AS Paese, count() AS IP, sum(req) AS Richieste, countIf(blk > 0) AS `IP bloccati`, countIf(blk = 0) AS `IP mai bloccati`, sum(blk) AS `Richieste bloccate` FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) panels.title: Paesi
panels.description: Per paese: IP distinti, quanti bloccati almeno una volta, richieste e percentuale bloccata. Clic sul paese per filtrare la dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(match(geo, '^[A-Z]{2}$'), concat(char(240, 159, 135, 166 + ascii(substring(geo, 1, 1)) - 65), char(240, 159, 135, 166 + ascii(substring(geo, 2, 1)) - 65), ' ', geo), if(geo = 'LAN', '🏠 LAN', '❔ ??')) AS Paese, geo AS cc, count() AS IP, countIf(blk > 0) AS `IP bloccati`, countIf(blk = 0) AS `Mai bloccati`, sum(req) AS Richieste, sum(blk) AS Bloccate, round(100 * Bloccate / greatest(Richieste, 1), 1) AS `% bloccate` FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') IN (${paese:singlequote})) GROUP BY ip HAVING ('__all__' IN (${stato:singlequote}) OR multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') IN (${stato:singlequote}))) GROUP BY geo ORDER BY IP DESC, Richieste DESC

panels.description: Per ogni intervallo: IP con almeno una richiesta bloccata e IP con sole richieste consentite.

IN (${paese:singlequote})) AND client_ip IN (SELECT ip FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') IN (${paese:singlequote})) GROUP BY ip HAVING ('__all__' IN (${stato:singlequote}) OR multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') IN (${stato:singlequote})))) GROUP BY t, client_ip) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT countIf(stato = 'bloccato') AS `Sempre bloccati`, countIf(stato = 'misto') AS `In parte bloccati`, countIf(stato = 'consentito') AS `Mai bloccati` FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') IN (${paese:singlequote})) GROUP BY ip HAVING ('__all__' IN (${stato:singlequote}) OR multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') IN (${stato:singlequote})))

panels.title: Reti / provider (ASN)
panels.description: Organizzazione proprietaria degli IP (database GeoIP ASN): utile per capire se il traffico bloccato arriva da hosting/cloud (bot) o da provider residenziali.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(asn_ = 0, '—', toString(asn_)) AS ASN, if(org = '', if(geo = 'LAN', 'rete locale', 'sconosciuto'), org) AS Organizzazione, count() AS IP, countIf(blk > 0) AS `IP bloccati`, sum(req) AS Richieste, sum(blk) AS Bloccate FROM (SELECT client_ip AS ip, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS stato FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') IN (${paese:singlequote})) GROUP BY ip HAVING ('__all__' IN (${stato:singlequote}) OR multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') IN (${stato:singlequote}))) GROUP BY ASN, Organizzazione ORDER BY `IP bloccati` DESC, IP DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: IP (max 1000) — clic su un IP per il dettaglio qui sotto o per aprirne le richieste
panels.description: Una riga per IP client. Stato: ⛔ tutte le richieste bloccate, ⚠ alcune bloccate, ✅ nessuna bloccata. Paese e organizzazione da GeoIP. 'Perché è stato bloccato' = cause dei blocchi (fino a 5). Per bloccare un IP a mano o metterlo in allowlist vedi il riquadro in fondo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') AS Stato, client_ip AS IP, if(match(geo, '^[A-Z]{2}$'), concat(char(240, 159, 135, 166 + ascii(substring(geo, 1, 1)) - 65), char(240, 159, 135, 166 + ascii(substring(geo, 2, 1)) - 65), ' ', geo), if(geo = 'LAN', '🏠 LAN', '❔ ??')) AS Paese, if(asn_ = 0, '', toString(asn_)) AS ASN, if(org = '', if(geo = 'LAN', 'rete locale', ''), org) AS Organizzazione, count() AS req, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS blk, req AS Richieste, blk AS Bloccate, round(100 * blk / req, 1) AS `% bloccate`, uniq(path) AS Percorsi, arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', groupUniqArray(site_id)), ', ') AS Siti, min(ts) AS `Prima vista`, max(ts) AS `Ultima vista`, if(blk = 0, NULL, maxIf(ts, action = 'BLOCK')) AS `Ultimo blocco`, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(5)(waf_causa(replaceRegexpOne(terminating_rule, '^.*/', ''), terminating_type), action = 'BLOCK'), ' · ') AS `Perché è stato bloccato`, any(user_agent) AS `User-Agent`, anyLast(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')) AS geo, anyLast(asn) AS asn_, anyLast(as_org) AS org FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ('__all__' IN (${paese:singlequote}) OR multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') IN (${paese:singlequote})) GROUP BY client_ip HAVING ('__all__' IN (${stato:singlequote}) OR multiIf(blk = 0, 'consentito', blk = req, 'bloccato', 'misto') IN (${stato:singlequote})) ORDER BY blk DESC, req DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Dettaglio IP: ${ip} (scrivi un IP, una parte o un CIDR nel filtro IP in alto)

targets.rawSql: SELECT client_ip AS IP, if(match(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??'), '^[A-Z]{2}$'), concat(char(240, 159, 135, 166 + ascii(substring(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??'), 1, 1)) - 65), char(240, 159, 135, 166 + ascii(substring(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??'), 2, 1)) - 65), ' ', multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??')), if(multiIf(country != '', country, (isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '127.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '100.64.0.0/10') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, '169.254.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fc00::/7') OR isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, 'fe80::/10') OR client_ip = '::1'), 'LAN', '??') = 'LAN', '🏠 LAN', '❔ ??')) SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(action != 'BLOCK') AS consentite, countIf(action = 'BLOCK') AS bloccate FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT waf_causa(replaceRegexpOne(terminating_rule, '^.*/', ''), terminating_type) AS Causa, if(terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'RateLimit', replaceRegexpOne(terminating_rule, '^[^/]*/', '')) AS Regola, count() AS Richieste, max(ts) AS Ultima FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY Causa, Regola ORDER BY Richieste DESC

panels.title: Ultime richieste dell'IP (clic su request_id per il dettaglio completo)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Ora, client_ip AS IP, site_id AS Sito, method AS Metodo, concat(path, if(query = '', '', concat('?', query))) AS URL, status AS Stato, action AS Esito, if(action = 'BLOCK', waf_causa(replaceRegexpOne(terminating_rule, '^.*/', ''), terminating_type), '') AS Causa, user_agent AS `User-Agent`, request_id FROM waf.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR position(client_ip, ${ip:sqlstring}) > 0 OR (match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$') AND isIPAddressInRange(client_ip, if(match(${ip:sqlstring}, '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+/[0-9]{1,3}$'), ${ip:sqlstring}, '255.255.255.255/32')))) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Come bloccare o sbloccare un IP

options.content:
**Bloccare** uno o più IP: scrivili (IP o CIDR, uno per riga) in `config/lists/custom-reputation.txt`
(crea la cartella se manca). Il WAF li carica entro 30 s e li blocca come la *AWSManagedIPReputationList*
(causa: *IP con cattiva reputazione*). Per sbloccarli togli la riga; per disattivare la lista svuota il file, non cancellarlo.

**Non bloccare mai** un IP (ufficio, monitoraggio, VPN aziendale): regola custom `allow` nel file del sito, es. `config/sites/odoo.yaml`:

```yaml
custom_rules:
  - name: AllowOffice
    slot: start
    action: allow
    match: {all: [{ip_set: [203.0.113.10/32, 192.168.10.0/24]}]}
```

**Bloccare interi paesi**: `geo_block: {countries: [CN, RU], action: block}` nel file del sito (serve `WAF_GEOIP=true` e i database in `data/geoip`).

Le modifiche a `config/sites/` sono applicate entro 10 s, senza riavvio. Controllo: `docker compose logs -f waf`.
